verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships an official CLI and Python SDK covering the full platform, with first-party docs stating that 'anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal.' It also offers a REST API with a probed OpenAPI spec, and documents scoped API keys explicitly for CI/CD and automation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage, and a documented CI-pipeline example (e.g. a GitHub Actions recipe).
